subject: Post-demo procurement & payment path — vendor portal vs PO invoicing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & payment path — quick next steps

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and action items so we stay aligned on procurement readiness / commercial path: 

Summary from the call:
- You liked the latency/cost projection for your search rerank workload and want to validate PO vs. credit-card/marketplace path.
- Procurement will need a vendor packet (W-9/W-8, banking info) and confirmation on invoice timing for PO.
- Security/attestation questions will follow but aren’t gating the initial pilot.

Suggested next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether Nimbus prefers vendor onboarding via your buyer portal (preferred by some Enterprise teams) or direct PO invoicing to Redwood?
2) If PO path: please share your standard PO terms (net30/45) and the contact for invoice routing.
3) If portal path: we’ll complete your vendor setup packet — I can attach a Redwood W-9 and banking stub to speed things up.

I attached a one-page W-9 stub to this message for your procurement team to preview. Marissa (cc’d) will own vendor setup from our side; looping her so she sees the timeline.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if helpful.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_W9_stub.pdf (PDF, 34 KB - stub)

From: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & payment path — quick next steps

Thanks Vivek — great demo. Quick answers from procurement POV: 

- Nimbus prefers PO invoicing for anything above $25k ARR. For smaller pilots, we can temporarily use our marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) if Redwood is listed — but that adds platform fees.
- Primary invoice contact: Marcus Lee (cc’d). Standard terms are Net30.
- Procurement will need a completed vendor packet including W-9, remit-to banking details, and a copy of our insurance certificate. I attached a short vendor intake template we use.

Can you have Marissa start the vendor packet? Marcus and I will pull together the PO routing details and confirm whether the pilot will go through Marketplace. We expect a decision by next week.

Olivia
Olivia Tran
Head of Vendor Ops | Nimbus Cloud
olivia.tran@nimbuscloud.com

Attachment: Nimbus_Vendor_Preferences.xlsx (Excel, 12 KB - template)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: procurement & payment path — vendor intake from Nimbus

Laura — forwarding Nimbus’ reply and vendor intake template.

Notes for finance/legal ops: 
- Prospect: Nimbus Cloud (deal NIM-2027-0421). They prefer PO invoicing for >$25k ARR; pilot may be Marketplace if under threshold.
- Requested by procurement: W-9, remit-to banking info, insurance cert. I already have a W-9 stub from Vivek (attached) — can you confirm if our banking details are current for vendor onboarding? Also need to know if we can/should accept AWS Marketplace billing for the pilot (fees vs speed).

Ask: Can you: 
1) Confirm Redwood’s remit-to banking details and provide the canonical vendor packet we use for buyer portals?
2) If PO path, confirm billing contact and whether Net30 is acceptable (they indicated Net30).

If helpful I can schedule a 15-min sync w/ Marcus and your team to walk through the packet — do you have availability tomorrow morning?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — copying next steps and attaching our standard vendor packet.

What I’m sending now:
- Redwood_Vendor_Packet_2027.pdf (includes remit-to, W-9, banking instructions, and insurance contact)
- Redwood_W9_filled.pdf (signed W-9)

Responses to asks:
1) Remit-to banking details: attached in the vendor packet (wire & ACH instructions included).
2) Net30: acceptable for the pilot / initial invoice, confirm via PO when you have it.
3) Marketplace: we can support AWS Marketplace for a short pilot, but the commercial terms will need an adjustment to account for marketplace fees (I included a short note in the vendor packet on typical fee impact).

I’ll also introduce our accounting specialist if Nimbus prefers to work directly through their portal for vendor onboarding — happy to join a sync on Friday morning PST.
